name: CMS GLP-1 Bridge Prior Authorization Request Form

patient.description: Patient details printed in the patient section of the form.

full_name.description: The patient's full name from the field labeled 'Patient name'.

mbi.description: The Medicare beneficiary MBI exactly as printed, preserving letters, digits, and separators.

date_of_birth.description: The patient date of birth exactly as printed.

address.description: The complete patient address exactly as printed in the address field.

prescriber.description: Prescriber details printed in the prescriber section of the form.

name.description: The prescriber's name and credentials exactly as printed.

phone.description: The prescriber phone number exactly as printed.

npi.description: The prescriber NPI exactly as printed, returned as text.

request.description: The selected drug and the answers marked in questions 1 through 3.

requested_drug.description: The exact requested-drug option marked under 'Requested drug (select one)'.

part_d_acknowledgement.description: Return 'Acknowledged' when that option is marked in question 1; otherwise return 'Not acknowledged'.

moderate_to_severe_osa.description: Return the exact marked 'Yes' or 'No' answer to question 2.

mash_with_fibrosis.description: Return the exact marked 'Yes' or 'No' answer to question 3.
